requirement: The system shall allow customers to book appointments.
Administrators shall be able to delete user accounts.
Users shall be able to reset their passwords.
Customers shall be able to search for available services.
The system shall export monthly reports, including totals, as CSV files.
Users shall be able to update their profile information.
Search results shall appear within two seconds.
The system shall maintain 99.9 percent availability.
Stored passwords shall be protected using a secure password hashing algorithm.
The system shall support 1000 concurrent users.
The application shall operate on Windows and Linux.
The system shall restore service within fifteen minutes after a failure.
